name: AssetResolver
brief: Callback that resolves an external asset (image or font) referenced by a loaded picture, such as the assets inside a Lottie file.
description: The callback is invoked synchronously during `Picture.load` for each external reference, so any data it needs must already be in memory — fetch and cache assets before loading, then resolve them here.
signature: export type AssetResolver = (paint: Paint, src: string) => boolean;
